## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Relevant manual flow tested when behavior is user-facing

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new behavior and error paths
- [ ] `README.md` and `README_zh.md` are synchronized when needed
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, signed URLs, local data, or generated output are included
- [ ] Security boundaries remain intact for outbound URLs and model output
